title: Continuity Visits with an Exiting Provider — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Health services computation sheet: the visits a continuity-of-care referral records under the Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

### Clause

(1) The continuity window is the practice type's continuity-of-care days, and the member is expected to see the provider at the standard continuity rate of **2 visits** per ninety-day period.

(2) The window visits are the rate multiplied by the window days and divided by the ninety-day period of **90 days**, rounded up to a whole visit.

(3) The visits recorded are never fewer than **1** and never more than the practice type's single-referral visit ceiling: they are the window visits, raised to 1 where they would be lower, and held to the ceiling where they would be higher.

### The quantities

| Quantity | Value or source |
|---|---|
| Window days | The continuity-of-care days of the member's practice type |
| Rate | 2 visits per 90-day period |
| Rounding | Up, to a whole visit, on the window visits |
| Floor | 1 visit |
| Ceiling | The single-referral visit ceiling of the member's practice type |

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- Window of 90 days: 2 multiplied by 90 is 180; divided by 90 is exactly 2. The visits recorded are **2**.
- Window of 75 days (a hypothetical value used only to show the rounding): 2 multiplied by 75 is 150; divided by 90 is 1.67, rounded up to **2**.
- Window of 30 days (hypothetical): 2 multiplied by 30 is 60; divided by 90 is 0.67, rounded up to **1**, which is also the floor.
- Where the window visits would exceed the practice type's single-referral visit ceiling, the visits recorded equal the ceiling.
